prompts: Create ONE individual animation frame PNG for a Unity 2D side-view pixel-art alien missile explosion. True transparent RGBA background, no checkerboard baked in, no black background, no scene, no text, no sprite sheet. Square 1024x1024 canvas. Explosion anchored exactly at canvas center (512,512), all pixels confined within central 900x900 area with transparent padding. Crisp chunky pixel clusters with dark purple outlines, arcade metal-slug-like sci-fi game effect, vivid orange and yellow flame with purple plasma accents and white hot core. Not photorealistic, no blurred aura, no ground shadow. One cohesive circular radial blast, never mushroom cloud. Consistent pixel cluster scale about 6px. This is one of FOUR chronological frames; do not draw other frames. FRAME 1 ignition: compact central starburst diameter about 300 pixels; white-yellow core, orange flame spikes and purple sparks. Mostly transparent canvas.
